### Donny Osmond Celebrates Five Years at Harrah’s Las Vegas, Extends Residency


08/27/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 493 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Donny-Osmond-Celebrates-Five-Years-at-Harrahs-Las-Vegas-Extends-Residency-2026.pdf)


***New dates through June 2027,*** ***tickets on sale at 8 a.m. PT***


*For show assets, click*[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftracking.us.nylas.com%2Fl%2F9452677689744e8eae94f05f06f1e9e1%2F0%2F550bb280c85f89531f0c131d519d5a4b7a9c4f5a89a8ae617273419b537613dc%3Fcache_buster%3D1741880672&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=40d24d75dbe56e1531704f7d3154b7d0)


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Legendary entertainer and music icon ****[Donny Osmond](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftracking.us.nylas.com%2Fl%2F9452677689744e8eae94f05f06f1e9e1%2F1%2F702850620db7a48b8b5976d3f110af64654934a58a9ea87c8ea7769bf118950d%3Fcache_buster%3D1741880672&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=Donny+Osmond&index=2&md5=b68269d9a1bd796effb9dc20e6982804) has once again extended his award-winning residency inside **Harrah’s Showroom** at[Harrah’s Las Vegas](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftracking.us.nylas.com%2Fl%2F9452677689744e8eae94f05f06f1e9e1%2F2%2Fd31de6897d1d6331a4d5b621d32ceb1d4f3b32c4cb6d6cc861bd091760fb5250%3Fcache_buster%3D1741880672&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=Harrah%26%238217%3Bs+Las+Vegas&index=3&md5=8fd8578eab7c73dc4a14bcc6b5c4c8ff) **through June 2027** . Celebrating the show’s fifth anniversary on The Strip, Osmond continues to dazzle his audience through his dynamic, energy-filled musical journey of his unparalleled life as one of the most recognized entertainers in the world.


“Between my time on stage at Flamingo and Harrah's, it’s been 16 wonderful years performing on The Strip, said Osmond. “16… still not quite old enough for the casinos, but it still feels like quite an accomplishment. I am grateful to the many fans who have sung along and danced with me over the years, and I look forward to continuing the fun in 2027. The Las Vegas community has been incredibly welcoming, and I am proud to call this city my second home.”


The latest addition to the show allows Osmond to lean into a growing technological trend by harnessing control of his Artificial Intelligence (AI) likeness to create a magical and memorable concert going experience for fans. Using state-of-the-art technology, original multi-track audio recordings from over 50 years ago and original footage from the 1970s, the worldwide song sensation “Puppy Love” is reimagined with AI to recreate and celebrate the 1972 hit. Audiences uniquely experience a special performance of Osmond in duet and a 3-D AI version of his 14-year-old self, live on stage.


Featuring the fan favorite “Auto-rap-ography” – a rap song accompanied by milestone photos and videos from his impressive career of six decades, the show treats fans to Osmond’s engaging performances and hit songs. The spectacular set also includes an interactive audience segment where anyone can request any song he's ever recorded across his decades of performance. Donny also does a full Broadway production of his classic Disney hit from Mulan, “I'll Make A Man Out Of You.”


Osmond won Best Resident Performer/Headliner and Best Production Show in the 2024 Las Vegas Review Journal Best of Las Vegas Awards, honors the show has taken each year since its 2021 debut.


For more information, scheduling and to purchase tickets, please visit[www.ticketmaster.com/donny](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ticketmaster.com%2Fdonny&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ticketmaster.com%2Fdonny&index=4&md5=47b18a39da338b5a8ce536625a714417) .


Tickets to the newly added performances are on sale at 8 a.m. PT. Limited tickets for the remainder of Donny’s 2026 performances are still available. Shows take place nightly from Tuesday to Saturday beginning at 7:30 p.m. Tickets for Donny’s Pre-Show VIP Experience – which includes a meet-and-greet, personal storytelling, Q&A and a special musical “moment” – are also available. In addition, guests looking to save by bundling show tickets and a hotel stay can visit the dedicated page linked[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftracking.us.nylas.com%2Fl%2F9452677689744e8eae94f05f06f1e9e1%2F3%2F08af3ff684f5aee73c7a445d3cca5de2106498a801c0c2623395305bf89cf6e9%3Fcache_buster%3D1741880672&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=5&md5=0fb689ad203737da2cfaa831288b9c63) .


Osmond’s residency is directed by Raj Kapoor, who has produced The GRAMMYs, Latin GRAMMYs, The Academy Awards, Academy of Country Music Awards and Emmy Awards. Kapoor has also directed and produced hit Las Vegas residencies for Shania Twain, Mariah Carey and the Backstreet Boys. The show is choreographed by Emmy Award-winning duo, NAPPYTABS. DONNY is produced by Mojave Ghost. Greg Young of Mojave Ghost has produced Tony and Drama Desk Award-winning productions on Broadway, as well as more than 2,500 concerts, 40 Broadway shows, national tours and IP exhibitions throughout the domestic U.S. Mojave Ghost has also produced Donny’s tours for the past decade.


**About Harrah’s Las Vegas**


A hidden gem in the heart of The Strip, Harrah’s Las Vegas features 2,542 redesigned guest rooms, a remodeled casino floor and direct access to CAESARS FORUM Conference Center. The renovated[hotel rooms](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fharrahs-las-vegas%2Fhotel&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=hotel+rooms&index=6&md5=4336107dcb98b0cbdc5eacba1980ee1e) and[suites](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fsuites&esheet=54595350&newsitemid=20260827900840&lan=en-US&anchor=suites&index=7&md5=e6f078d7b137c8e6ecd0483f363b7e5e) feature bold purple and blue hues that complement the cream-colored décor, dark wood accents and contemporary fixtures. The resort offers 87,000 square feet of casino space, the new Lounge, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Harrah's Las Vegas, The Spa at Harrah’s Las Vegas and more than 25,000 square feet of meeting and convention space. Dining options encompass everything from Ramsay’s Kitchen from Chef Gordon Ramsay and PizzaCake by Buddy Valastro, to the chef-driven Fulton Street Food Hall featuring Bobby’s Burgers by acclaimed Chef Bobby Flay and Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, to the upscale setting of Ruth’s Chris Steak House, a romantic venue with breathtaking views of The Strip. Harrah’s outdoor bar, Carnaval Court, brings high energy to the Las Vegas Strip with live music and some of the world’s top flair bartenders who juggle and pour to perfection. A wide variety of entertainment options include the first-ever solo residency from Donny Osmond, as well as Taylor Dayne, Menopause The Musical, X Country, Colin Cloud: Mastermind and MJ LIVE. Harrah’s Las Vegas is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
